gosvāmī
(‘master of the senses’)
------------------------------------------
This word can be used as an honorific for anyone who has mastered his senses. However, it is normally used as a title indicating the religious status of a person. It is much more common among the Vaiṣṇavas (followers of the विष्णु cults).
A Vaiṣṇava गोस्वामी (or gosāī or gusāī) may be a monk or a householder. He may be the head of a religious institution or just an ordinary devotee.
The luminaries among the gosvāmīs are the following spiritual leaders of the चैतन्य cult (followers of Śrī कृष्ण चैतन्य of Bengal): Rūpa गोस्वामी (A.

-1558) and जीव गोस्वामी (16th cent. A. D.).
Tulasīdās, the famous author of the monumental work, the Rāmcaritmānas was a गोस्वामी too.
The word is also used as a surname, for the descendants of the gosvāmīs.

-1137) was the most important of the teachers of Viśiṣṭādvaita Vedānta and one of the most prominent religious leaders of श्रीवैष्णव cult. After taking सṁन्यास by himself before Lord वरदराज, the deity of the temple in काञ्चीपुरम् (in Tamil Nadu) he left for श्रीरङ्गम् (also in Tamil Nadu) to grace the pontificate, lying vacant due to the death of the previous incumbent, यामुनाचार्य (10th cent. A. D.). He was advised by Mahāpūrṇa, the seniormost disciple of यामुनाचार्य, to get initiation into the Vaiṣṇava cult from another, highly respected, teacher of the times, Goṣṭhī-pūrṇa. When Rāmānuja approached him, he is said to have postponed the event 18 times, just to test the earnestness of the disciple! However, Rāmānuja rose to the occasion and गोष्ठीपूर्ण had to yield at last!
When the great teacher imparted the well-known अष्टाक्षरी-मन्त्र (See AṢṬĀKṢARĪ.), he commanded Rāmānuja to keep it an absolute secret since those who heard it would be liberated whereas those who imparted it to unworthy persons would go to हेल्ल्. Rāmānuja hastened to a nearby temple, quickly climbed to the top of its gopuram (gateway tower), called out to the people to assemble there and loudly imparted the esoteric मन्त्र to one and all! When गोष्ठीपूर्ण got the news, he was furious and called for his errant disciple immediately. Rāmānuja, however, expressed his willingness to go to eternal हेल्ल्, with great joy in his heart, since so many ordinary people who, otherwise, might not, have got the opportunity for लिबेरतिओन्, would now surely get it! गोष्ठीपूर्ण realised the magnanimity of Rāmānuja and fell at his feet!
